import pandas as pd

@fig-runtime-rating shows each film's runtime and rating. 

::: {.cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb rating")
plt.show()
```
